## Problem

Which investigation step is awkward or missing? A short "today I have to…" description is enough.

## Proposal

What should the analyst be able to do, and where: the workbench, a collector, the command line, a report, or configuration?

Keep the tool observational. os-int records public information and local evidence. Proposals for remote access, exploitation, credential attacks, or active probes will be declined.

## How it fits

- Which existing screen, command, or collector would grow?
- Should the new record carry provenance (`collected`, `external`, `analyst`, or `agent`)?
- Does a collector need a new external program, and is that program passive?

## Alternatives

What you do today, and why it falls short.

## See also

The [user guide](https://github.com/pjourney/osint-rat/blob/main/docs/guide.md) and [architecture notes](https://github.com/pjourney/osint-rat/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) describe the current behavior and the layer a change would live in.
